input_text:
Synthetic example, not real intelligence. During the incident response investigation on workstation WS-04, analysts identified that the adversary attempted to establish persistence by adding an entry to the user Run key. The suspicious execution observed in the forensic timeline was:
reg.exe add HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run /v Updater /d C:\Users\student\x.exe
This command configured the binary x.exe located in the user directory to execute automatically upon user logon.
gate_reason: Too narrow: caught extracted line but missed hidden variant
rule_yaml:
title: Registry Entry Added for Persistence
status: test
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_img:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\reg.exe'
    selection_cli:
        CommandLine|contains|all:
            - 'HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run'
            - '/v Updater'
            - '/d C:\Users\student\x.exe'
    condition: all of selection_*
level: high
tags:
    - attack.persistence
    - attack.t1547.001
